FFmpeg call overhead

Each call starts a process and exchanges WAV files. An unchanged clip measures that round trip.

Limiter 2 tests

Check a sample-peak ceiling and output timeline alignment on a low probe followed by an overload. Internal latency reporting and intersample brickwall limiting are separate contracts.

Back to comparison · audio API · Case definitions · Expected results

dynamics.limiter · canonical

dynamics.limiter.ceiling-latency limiter
{
  "id": "dynamics.limiter.ceiling-latency",
  "feature": "dynamics.limiter",
  "title": "Limiter ceiling and timeline alignment (5 ms lookahead)",
  "status": "active",
  "tier": "quality",
  "fixture": {
    "sampleRate": 48000,
    "channels": 1,
    "frames": 48000,
    "signal": "segments",
    "segments": [
      {
        "signal": "silence",
        "frames": 4800
      },
      {
        "signal": "impulse",
        "amplitude": 0.1,
        "at": 0,
        "frames": 4800
      },
      {
        "signal": "dc",
        "value": 0.8,
        "frames": 28800
      },
      {
        "signal": "silence",
        "frames": 9600
      }

  },

      "op": "limiter",

    "probeThreshold": 0.05,

    "Measured latency is effective output alignment, not a claim about internal algorithm latency metadata."
  ]
}
